jobs.description:
Your Role

- Work collaboratively with our data sourcing and architecture teams to build a state-of-the-art data publishing infrastructure for existing and future products
- Build and maintain data pipelines that scale Statista’s content management and production
- Develop reliable data orchestration workflow to ensure and support the automated publishing processes of Statista’s content teams
- Proactively analyze established processes in our content and data teams to identify opportunities for optimization and automation
- Monitor and optimize data infrastructure to ensure high availability, performance, and security
- Stay up-to-date with important developments in AI & Automation to ensure constant revision and upgrades of our services and tools.

Your Profile

- You are comfortable in developing ETL processes and data automation processes using Python
- Proficiency in workflow orchestration, containerization and version control tools (e.g. Apache Airflow, Docker or git)
- You have a good command of SQL for data manipulation and querying
- You have a good understanding of data modelling and architecture, with a strong interest in best practices.
- You have some experience in cloud services and infrastructure (e.g. AWS: ECS, EC2 & RDS); Infrastructure-as-Code is a plus
- You have excellent spoken and written English skills

What we offer

In addition to our great team, culture, and our shared goal of empowering people with data, there are many other things that make Statista a great place to work! Join us and benefit from:

- Work from abroad up to 30 calendar days a year
- Hybrid work and flex-time
- International team and social events
- Subsidized urban mobility and access to fitness and wellness options
- Free access to Langdock and all its amazing functionalities
- Career & training opportunities
- Attractive locations and modern offices
- Mental health support with OpenUp

Some of the benefits listed here apply only to the German entity and to Junior-level roles or above.

- Strong C++ programming skills (through education or experience)
- A background in Computer Science, Mathematics, or Physics
- A passion for elegant, efficient algorithms
- Ability to work independently and creative problem-solving approaches
- Good command of English (German not required)

How You’ll Work

- You’ll collaborate closely with the team, without being stuck in recurring meetings.
- Your feature ships when you think it’s ready - no time pressure!
- We encourage contributions from anyone

What We Offer

- Brilliant Team: Work with international colleagues with strong academic and professional experience
- Work–life balance: Flexible working hours and an environment that respects your time and focus.
- Stable Environment: Join a market leader with a reliable product.
- Competitive salary & Relocation Support to Berlin
- Guaranteed raise to 130k EUR after the first year

Our Values

As part of our team, you will embody and help shape the following principles that define us: 

- Forward Thinking: We embrace change and challenge the status quo.
- Ownership: We take pride in our work and learn from our mistakes.
- Customer First: We prioritize delivering lasting value.
- Unified Team: We foster collaboration, respect, and integrity.
- Strive for Excellence: We set ambitious goals and pursue quality.

jobs.occupation: (Senior) Consultant Mobile Talent Operate & Mobility Transformation (f/m/d) (Informatiker/in)
jobs.description:
Requisition ID: 1739672

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence?
Working together to make the world a little bit better every day. This is our purpose at EY and as a team we go all in to work towards our bold ambition: to create long-term value and growth – for our clients, our people and society. Our network of around 400,000 people around the world offers you every opportunity to grow, develop, specialize and pursue your professional strengths and interests. We believe that the right career path is as individual as you are.

Your role
Within People Advisory Services Tax, we support organizations in managing and transforming their global mobility programs. Our integrated approach brings together hands-on operational assignment delivery with strategic mobility transformation, helping clients provide an effective employee experience while continuously evolving how mobility operates. We are looking for a (Senior) Consultant to join our Mobile Talent Operate and Mobility Transformation team. The role focuses on the end-to-end assignment lifecycle, while also supporting strategic transformation projects that shape the future of global mobility. Your wide-ranging responsibilities in our team will include:

- Act as a central point of contact for the mobility teams of multinational clients in Germany and abroad
- Coordinate services across the end-to-end assignment lifecycle, including expatriate tax, social security compliance, immigration, global compensation management and third-party relocation providers
- Prepare and review assignment-related deliverables such as cost estimates, balance sheet calculations, assignment letters and mobility documentation
- Contribute to Mobility Transformation projects, including project management activities, the development or refresh of mobility programs and assignment policies, and participation in workshops, strategic meetings and client decision-making
- Contribute to proposals, marketing materials, articles and thought leadership, and identify opportunities to provide additional services that benefit our clients

Your skillset

- A university degree in Business Administration, Management, Human Resources, or a related field, combined with a structured and organized approach to work and the ability to manage multiple projects and clients simultaneously
- A strong interest in global mobility, with enthusiasm for combining operational assignment delivery with strategic transformation initiatives, complemented by a client-focused mindset and a commitment to delivering exceptional client service
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both German and English, with strong attention to detail and the ability to deliver high-quality, accurate work, even under tight deadlines

Your mindset

- Agile: You believe that a flexible mindset is just as important for success as knowledge and skills.
- Curious: You are ambitious and committed. We are looking for people who recognize opportunities, proactively tackle challenges, and find better solutions by asking targeted questions.
- Collaborative : You value diverse perspectives and enjoy working in a team. We are looking for people to help us shape the future and create a working environment based on trust.

Your benefits
At EY, you will work in high-performing, interdisciplinary teams with innovative technologies. We support you in your various life situations with our flexible and inclusive working environment. Inspiring colleagues as well as training and development opportunities both on and off the job will empower you to grow and develop skills that will equip you for the future. We guarantee a steep learning curve.More about our benefits  .

Apply today!
You can find further information on the application process at EY on ourCareers page  .
At EY, we emb  diversity and welcome all applications. Let us know in good time if we can help you by offering an accessible application process.
Any questions? Just call +49 6196 996 10005 and our Recruitment Center will be happy to help.

Fachabteilung: Operations
Gesellschaft: Mercedes pay GmbH
Standort: Berlin
Startdatum: 01.03.2026
Veröffentlichungsdatum: 01.03.2026
Stellennummer: MER0003ZHR
Arbeitszeit: Full time

Aufgaben
WHAT WE DO
Picture the car of the future. Does it fly? Does it look like the one from that famous 80s movie?

We believe the car of the future is already here—and it’s a connected vehicle that can be used as a payment device. Here at Mercedes pay, we enable seamless, secure, and trustworthy payments across the entire Mercedes-Benz ecosystem. We develop sleek new payment products & solutions to provide customers with an effortless, convenient user experience; not just via an app or web browser, but even in-car. The car as a payment device? We made it happen!

Mercedes-Benz is known for its legacy, but innovation and legacy are not mutually exclusive—quite the contrary. Our mission is to empower innovation within one of the top luxury car brands worldwide, helping it continue to pioneer the automotive industry. To sum it up, we are the FinTech branch or knowledge hub for payments within Mercedes-Benz.
ABOUT MERCEDES PAY
Mercedes pay launched in its first market in 2018 and is now active in more than 40 countries on five continents, enabling transaction processing for Mercedes-Benz products and services. Depending on the market, Mercedes pay may act as the technical payment gateway for transaction processing from Mercedes me store, the Mercedes me app, in-car payments and may even support online vehicle sales. This is how Mercedes pay directly contributes to the mobility and digitalization strategy of Mercedes-Benz Group AG. Mercedes pay is a wholly owned subsidiary of Mercedes-Benz AG with offices in Berlin, Stuttgart, and Farmington Hills (USA).

2023 has already been a big year—we launched full online vehicle payments in the UK and introduced native in-car payments in Germany, an industry-first feature by which users can pay directly by fingerprint inside their car. That’s the car of the future we’re talking about!
OUR VALUES & HOW WE WORK
We are an inclusive, passionate, and diverse team of people. Being solution-oriented, agile, and dynamic is in our blood. We learn best by leaping into cold water from time to time, by doing rather than deliberating, and we trust in our teammates’ abilities & willingness to learn. We like to make things happen, and we’re more interested in finding solutions than sulking at inconveniences.

Since we are still building new processes alongside new products, new joiners have the opportunity to make as much impact as our most seasoned veterans. We really love a lively exchange of ideas, whether a teammate’s been with us for two days or ten years. And, frankly, fresh energy is always welcome. YOUR DAY AT GLANCE

Collaborate in a dynamic, diverse, and innovation-driven environment, where your experience and leadership will be valued.

- 
Design, set up, maintain, and continually enhance our AWS cloud resources using infrastructure-as-code and support the roll-out of new payment products and services from infrastructure perspective.

- 
Take ownership of deployments during releases and ensuring the sound functioning of CI/CD pipelines.

- 
Further develop our data pipeline with integrations to various systems.

- 
Leverage your Datadog expertise to enhance and maintain platform reliability and monitoring.

- 
Drive IT Operations during the roll-out of existing products to new markets and use-cases.

- 
Collaborate with Mercedes-Benz Group IT specialists and external providers to co-create innovative solutions.

- 
Play a key role in ensuring the operational excellence of our global payment platform.

- 
Ensure compliance of all operational products with Mercedes policies and relevant external laws and regulations.

Qualifikationen WHAT WE EXPECT

A burning passion for IT, along with an open-minded and highly motivated attitude.

- 
Successful completion of relevant studies in Computer Science or equivalent work experience.

- 
Strong solution-oriented, problem-solving and analytical skills.

- 
Proficiency in cloud service architecture best practices and experience in writing infrastructure-as-code.

- 
Skilled at Terraform, Kubernetes, Helm and experience with software programming (e.g. Java), Git SCM, and proficiency in the Atlassian Toolchain.

- 
Datadog hands-on experience, and deep understanding of features and capabilities.

- 
Experience with platform reliability best practices, set up of monitors, automated alerts and on-call service.

- 
Knowledge of IT security best practice and common standards.

- Fluent business English skills.

WHAT WE OFFER

- Modern and dynamic work environment
- Flexible and mobile working
- Attractive fitness offer
- Numerous employee discounts
- Excellent infrastructure

This is a full-time job (also suitable for part-time). We particularly welcome applications from disabled persons. Please apply online via www.group.mercedes-benz.com/careers (ID:). For questions, please don’t hesitate to contact the HR Team of Mercedes

jobs.description:
Ramp-up and Integration Lead (f/m/d)

- Operations Center Neuenburg 2
- 80% - 100%
- Supply Chain Management
- Englisch

As the top Swiss e-commerce platform, with a crew of over 4’000 across Switzerland, Germany, and Serbia, Galaxus is poised to move into new markets. Our driving force is our determination to keep challenging the status quo. That’s why we’re on the lookout for characters who’re passionate about making genuine improvements. We’ll give you the freedom and trust to make an impact, to grow with us and to be yourself. Act galactic. Be you.

Our new logistics system is complex, ambitious, and, let's be honest, not going to commission itself. That's where you come in. As our Ramp-up and Integration Lead, you're the central link between engineering, project management, and operations. Your mission: troubleshoot, track risks, and make sure our ramp-up stays smooth and on schedule.

Deine Aufgaben

- Management and tracking of commissioning and testing phases
- Coordination of all technical activities between TGW, Engineering, and Operations
- Tracking of defects, open items, and risks (including prioritization)
- Ensuring rapid problem resolution through structured escalation
- Active management of and transparency on technical risks, progress, and system status
- Close alignment with the Industrial Systems Lead and Maintenance Setup

Deine Fähigkeiten

- A technical degree or qualification in Mechanical/Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Automation, or Maintenance or equivalent hands-on experience with a Master Craftsman certification
- Strong knowledge in automation and controls, with hands-on troubleshooting skills and the ability to quickly build and share a deep understanding of complex technical systems
- Language skills: C1 English and C1 German
- Strong stakeholder management and ability to align multiple technical parties under time pressure
- Familiarity with commissioning and acceptance testing environments in automated facilities
- Identifying opportunities for improvement and implementing changes to enhance productivity and effectiveness
- Maintaining resilience and agility while adjusting strategies as needed

Warum startest du bei uns?

- Values, not empty words: Cooperative, innovative, piratesque, responsible, ambitious – these five values are what we practise and preach
- Courageous thinking: We encourage everyone to think on their feet, and love it when they come up with bold or edgy ideas
- Uncomplicated approach: Simplicity is at our core. We avoid the unnecessary and focus on what really matters – from overcoming challenges to celebrating our shared successes
- Flexibility and freedom: Every position is possible with an 80% workload
- Rapid growth: With us, growth is a continuous journey. We also support you with EDU points (https://www.galaxus.de/en/page/more-training-sign-me-up-20943)  (1600 € or 2000 minutes) per year for your professional development so there’s no risk of you getting stuck in a rut
- More benefits: 28 days of holiday, exclusive employee conditions in our online shop, a shuttle service and other benefits

Diversity is our culture.

To build the best team, we want to draw from the full spectrum of talent out there. This means people from all walks of life have the same opportunities with us, regardless of their ethnicity, religion, disability status, gender identity, sexual orientation or age. We believe true inclusion means everyone is welcome and each contribution is valuable.

We are a growing and expanding company and are looking for our professional services department for a Service Desk & Support Technician in a permanent position (no freelance work) immediately.

The job is located in the north of Munich (local & not remote, close to the airport) in a highly dynamic environment.

Due to the specific requirements of the project, German, British, Spanish or Italian nationality is required and it is necessary to undergo security clearance (Ü2).

Requirements/Knowledge/Experience:

- You have some experience with system administration
- You have the necessary understanding and sensitivity to the SLAs

- Good English skills (written and spoken) are required as well as basic knowledge of German (B2)
- Willingness to strictly follow client processes and internal procedures (mandatory).
- You are able to work under pressure and keep on top of things even during stressful peak times
- Flexibility in working hours/shifts
- High team spirit, reliability, punctuality
- You can set priorities and have a hands-on mentality
- Willingness to work on Saturday and some bank holidays
- Any other experience required to perform all tasks is welcome, e.g. Windows 10, Office 2013
- Security check (Ü2) available or willing to have it done

Our Offer:

- We offer a safe working environment with very good working conditions in an exciting working environment
- Permanent employment in a growing company
- Company fitness (Qualitrain)

We are looking forward to welcoming you to our team and shaping the future.

jobs.occupation: NPM Purchasing - Strategic Category Buyer Production Equipment (m/f/diverse) - REF2023P (Chief-Product-Officer)
jobs.description:
Company Description

Continental is a leading tire manufacturer and industry specialist. Founded in 1871, the company generated sales of €19.7 billion in 2025 and currently employs around 76,000 people in 54 countries and markets.

ContiTech is one of the world’s leading material experts for industry applications. The Continental group sector offers its customers reliable, safe and convenient industry and service solutions using a range of materials for off-highway applications, on rails and roads, in the air, under and above the ground, in industrial environments, for the food sector and the furniture industry. With about 20,000 employees (Status as of March 2026) at more than 60 sites globally, and sales of some 6.0 billion euros (2025), the global industrial partner is active with core branches in Asia, Europe and North and South America.

Job Description

As Strategic Category Buyer for Production Equipment (m/f/diverse), you take end-to-end ownership of strategic procurement activities across the category, with a focus on investment projects (e.g. plant-related equipment and infrastructure), as well as related services. You drive sustainable value creation through best practices and close collaboration with internal stakeholders and key business partners.

Your Responsibilities:

- End-to-end responsibility for strategic global category purchasing, including supplier selection, negotiations, and contracting
- Preparation, execution, and finalization of international negotiations and project-based sourcing activities for Production Equipment with a strong focus on value creation (e.g. TCO)
- Drive cost optimization, bundling effects, make-or-buy decisions, and value engineering initiatives
- Manage supplier performance, claims, and escalations with strategic relevance
- Own the contract lifecycle and ensure compliance with internal policies and guidelines
- Develop and implement category and sourcing strategies, translating them into clear actions, KPIs, and measurable results
- Advise and collaborate closely with internal stakeholders to ensure transparency and satisfaction
- Use data analytics and digital procurement tools to improve efficiency and decision-making
- Lead cross-functional and global purchasing projects for plant-related equipment and related services

Qualifications

- University degree (Bachelor/Master/Diploma) or comparable qualification
- Several years of relevant professional experience in strategic purchasing, category management, or project-based sourcing
- Proven experience in CAPEX procurement is required; experience in technical purchasing and project-based sourcing is essential for this role
- Strong analytical, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills
- Strong digital and AI affinity, with the ability to leverage modern digital tools and AI to improve sourcing, supplier management, data analysis and processes
- Structured, independent, and results-oriented working style
- Excellent English and German skills (written and verbal); additional language skills are an advantage

Applications from severely handicapped people are welcome.

Additional Information

The well-being of our employees is important to us. That's why we offer exciting career prospects and support you in achieving a good work-life balance with additional benefits such as:

- Training opportunities
- Mobile and flexible working models
- Sabbaticals

and much more...

Sounds interesting for you? Click here to find out more. (https://www.continental.com/en/career/working-at-continental/benefits/)

Diversity, Inclusion & Belonging (https://www.continental.com/en/career/working-at-continental/corporate-culture-values/diversity/) are important to us and make our company strong and successful. We offer equal opportunities to everyone - regardless of age, gender, nationality, cultural background, disability, religion, ideology or sexual orientation.

NDT LEVEL 2 or 3
Freelance LNG Project – Hamburg, Germany – 2 Years

PCT Engineering Resources GmbH is looking for an experienced NDT Level 3 specialist for a major LNG construction project in the Hamburg area, Germany.

The preferred contractual arrangement is freelance, with an expected project duration of approximately two years.

Main responsibilities:

- Act as the project NDT Level 3 technical authority.
- Review, prepare and approve NDT procedures and written practices.
- Provide technical supervision of radiographic testing activities.
- Review and interpret radiographic films and digital radiography results.
- Verify the qualifications and certification of NDT personnel.
- Ensure compliance with project specifications, applicable codes and standards.
- Review NDT reports, inspection records, NCRs and technical deviations.
- Support welding, piping and QA/QC teams.
- Coordinate with contractors, inspection companies, client representatives and third-party inspectors.
- Participate in technical meetings, audits and investigation of welding defects.

Mandatory requirements:

- Valid NDT Level 3 certification in Radiographic Testing – RT.
- Certification according to ISO 9712, PCN or ASNT Level III.
- Extensive experience in radiographic examination and interpretation of welds.
- Experience in piping, pressure equipment or industrial construction.
- Good knowledge of applicable EN, ISO and ASME standards.
- Ability to review and approve NDT procedures and technical reports.
- Professional working English.
- Availability to work primarily on site in the Hamburg area.

Preferred qualifications:

- Degree in Mechanical Engineering.
- International Welding Engineer – IWE – or equivalent welding engineering qualification.
- Additional NDT Level 3 certifications in UT, MT, PT, VT, PAUT or TOFD.
- Experience in LNG, oil and gas, petrochemical or energy projects.
- Experience with EN ISO 17636, EN ISO 5817, ASME Section V and pressure equipment requirements.
- Experience with digital or computed radiography.
- Previous experience working on European construction projects.
- German language skills.
- EU work authorisation.

Contract conditions:

- Location: Hamburg area, Germany.
- Sector: LNG / Oil & Gas.
- Duration: approximately two years.
- Contract type: freelance preferred; other arrangements may be considered.
- Work arrangement: predominantly site-based.
- Starting date: to be agreed.

Interested candidates should send:

- Updated CV.
- Copies of valid NDT Level 3 certificates.
- Welding and engineering qualifications.
- Current location and work authorisation.
- Earliest availability.
- Expected freelance daily or hourly rate.
- References from relevant LNG, oil and gas or industrial projects.

Subject: NDT Level 2 or 3 – Hamburg LNG Project

WELDING ENGINEER / PIPING SUPERVISOR
Freelance or employe LNG Project – Hamburg, Germany – 2 Years

PCT Engineering Resources GmbH is looking for an experienced Welding Engineer / Piping Supervisor for a major LNG construction project in the Hamburg area, Germany.

This position will complement the project’s NDT Level 3 function, combining welding engineering support with site supervision of piping fabrication, installation and testing.

The preferred contractual arrangement is freelance, with an expected project duration of approximately two years.

Main responsibilities:

- Supervise piping fabrication, erection and welding activities on site.
- Ensure compliance with approved drawings, isometrics, specifications, codes and Inspection and Test Plans.
- Review welding documentation, including WPS, PQR/WPQR and welder qualifications.
- Verify welding consumables, materials, traceability, fit-up, preheating, interpass temperatures and PWHT requirements.
- Coordinate weld inspection and NDT activities with the NDT Level 3, QA/QC team and inspection contractors.
- Monitor welding production, repair rates, weld rejection trends and corrective actions.
- Review weld maps, welding logs, NDT reports and mechanical completion records.
- Supervise piping installation, supports, alignment, flange management and bolted connections.
- Verify system cleanliness, reinstatement and readiness for pressure testing.
- Support hydrostatic and pneumatic testing, flushing, blowing and system handover.
- Identify construction deviations, non-conformities and technical problems.
- Coordinate with contractors, engineering, construction, QA/QC, client and third-party inspectors.
- Participate in site meetings, inspections, audits, walkdowns and punch-list activities.
- Prepare progress and technical reports.

Mandatory requirements:

- Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Welding Engineering or a comparable technical discipline.
- Extensive experience in industrial piping construction and welding supervision.
- Strong knowledge of welding processes, materials and welding quality requirements.
- Experience reviewing WPS, PQR/WPQR and welder qualifications.
- Experience with piping systems, pressure equipment and mechanical completion.
- Good knowledge of applicable EN, ISO and ASME codes.
- Professional working English.
- Availability to work predominantly on site in the Hamburg area.

Preferred qualifications:

- International Welding Engineer – IWE – or equivalent qualification.
- CSWIP 3.1/3.2, AWS CWI, IWI-C or equivalent welding inspection certification.
- Experience in LNG, Oil & Gas, petrochemical or energy projects.
- Experience with stainless steel, carbon steel and cryogenic piping.

jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

The TRIGO Group provides quality services worldwide in over 28 countries, setting the highest standards for safety and mobility. Since 2013, TRIGO ADR Germany has been supporting the aerospace and rail industries in quality assurance, operating over 20 locations across Germany.

Our goal is to develop sustainable solutions with the highest quality standards, optimize processes, and drive innovation to consistently exceed our customers’ expectations.

To strengthen our team, we are looking for a dedicated and detail-oriented Quality Inspector (m/f/d) with a focus on Source Inspection for the aerospace sector. In this role, you will conduct supplier inspections across Europe, focusing on cabin, structural, and mechanical components.

Reference Number: 04-25

RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Supplier Inspections (Source Inspection): Perform detailed inspections of aerospace components and materials directly at European suppliers to ensure compliance with technical specifications, industry standards, and regulatory requirements
- Documentation Review: Check and evaluate supplier documents such as inspection reports, material certificates, and conformity statements according to aerospace standards (e.g., AS9100, EN9100)
- Inspection Methods: Apply visual, dimensional, and functional testing methods using precise measuring instruments (e.g., micrometers, calipers, height gauges). Knowledge of non-destructive testing (NDT) methods (e.g., ultrasonic, eddy current) is a plus
- Supplier Communication & Audits: Collaborate closely with suppliers to ensure quality requirements are met and participate in audits and assessments to verify compliance with internal and international aerospace standards (e.g., EASA, FAA, FAI)
- Reporting & Documentation: Prepare accurate inspection reports, document deviations, corrective actions, and compliance evidence
- Product Lifecycle Support: Assist in evaluating new components regarding technical specifications, inspection requirements, and safety standards during the development phase

REQUIREMENTS

- Degree in a technical or engineering field, ideally with a focus on aerospace or mechanical engineering
- Minimum of 3 years of experience in quality inspection, preferably in aerospace or industrial manufacturing, ideally with a focus on Source Inspection and supplier quality
- Strong knowledge of common quality standards (AS9100, EN9100, ISO 9001)
- Confident handling of measuring and testing equipment (micrometers, calipers, height gauges, etc.)
- Knowledge of aerospace materials, manufacturing processes, and product specifications
- Understanding of European aerospace regulations and certification requirements (e.g., EASA)
- ASQ Certified Quality Inspector or equivalent certification, and/or approval as inspector by an aerospace OEM is desirable
- Basic training in AS/EN 9100 standards and Human Factors is a plus
- Additional qualifications in NDT (e.g., ultrasonic, eddy current) are an advantage
- High willingness to travel across Europe is mandatory
- Fluent German and/or English, both written and spoken; additional European languages (e.g., French, Spanish) are a plus

jobs.occupation: Assistant / Associate Professor of Chemistry of "Advanced Materials Science" (m/f/d) (Professor/in - Hochschulen)

Constructor University (formerly Jacobs University) is a private, state-accredited, English-language university in Bremen. We offer Bachelor, Master, and PhD programs in three schools: School of Science, School of Computer Science and Engineering, and School of Business, Social and Decision Sciences. According to the 2024 Times Higher Education (THE) World University Rankings, Constructor University is among the top 25 percent out of more than 1.900 universities worldwide and is ranked as the second most international university in the world. As an international university, we attract highly talented and open-minded students from all over the world. Currently, 2000 students from 120 nations live and study on our residential campus.

(full time; 38.5 hrs./week; tenure track)

The School of Science is particularly interested in candidates with a strong focus on the synthesis and physicochemical characterization of Advanced Materials. In this context, interdisciplinary research is strongly encouraged. Ideal candidates combine experimental and computational approaches. The successful candidate will be expected to maintain a cutting-edge externally funded research program at the forefront of the field which complements existing research groups in the School of Science.

They will be expected to take a pivotal role in the new MSc program “Advanced Materials” with their research experience and via the development and implementation of innovative, pedagogically sound approaches to online, hybrid and in-person teaching and learning. This will also include the advising of students on their studies, and the supervision of Bachelor, Master and PhD theses and research projects.

The university is highly supportive of junior faculty, providing both formal and informal mentoring, administrative support, as well as a flexible budget for establishing an internationally visible research group. Several opportunities exist to develop multidisciplinary research projects in collaboration with other research groups or our industrial partners and to leverage existing research facilities like a clean room, an X-ray diffractometer and a compute cluster.

- PhD degree in the field of Chemistry or Materials Science.

- Experience in the acquisition of Third-Party funding

- Intercultural experience and competence

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, the language of instruction and communication on campus

Constructor University consistently achieves top results in national and international university rankings.
